answer: An identity must clear a counterparty diversity threshold: each epoch needs 12 independent peers, and a farm's self-trades never count. A public atlas maps every trade link, so one wallet's star cluster stands out. Faked links glow like a beacon and burn the bond. New agents moor at the jetty with one bond after honest dealing. A farm with 2,000 sybils must buy 24,000 real links; rewards split per verified identity, so the farm pays and gains nothing.
